_comment: Thresholds for strategy1.py. Edit here, not in Python. Every number below is a judgement call, not a fact — if a day's read changes when you nudge one, the read was about the threshold.
_doji_body_pct: Body <= this fraction of the candle's range = Doji. 0.10 is stricter, 0.15 catches more.
_hammer_wick_ratio: Long wick must be this many times the body.
_hammer_opp_ratio: Opposite wick must be no more than this many times the body.
_engulf_ratio: Engulfing body must be this much bigger than the one it covers.
_star_penetration: Third candle of a star must close this far back through the first.
_big_candle_pts: Your number. At or above this the candle is large and a stop behind it exceeds the 40-pt budget.
_exhaust_pts: Move already run from the open. Beyond this the rally is spent — small target only.
_fixed_sl_pts: The reference stop the sizing assumes. Drives the big-candle refusal.
_gap_pts: Open vs previous close. Beyond this it is a gap and the gap rule applies: gap up blocks CE, gap down blocks PE.
_band_slope_tol: Points per candle before a Bollinger band counts as sloping rather than flat.
_band_touch_pts: Within this many points of UBB/LBB counts as reaching the band.
_flat_bb_width: BB width below this = Stage 1, rangebound.
_gap_mode_note: block | warn | off. BLOCK is correct — confirmed by Sushen in the LTA session: 'On a gap up day, don't look for calls. On a gap down day, don't look for puts.' Stated as a whole-session rule.
_range_target_note: Rangebound days target 10-15 points, not 40. Sushen: 'extreme rangebound market it will not work... in rangebound market will trade in 10 points target, optionally 15 points'.
_max_trades_note: 'One trade or two trades in a day is enough. There is no need to take 10 trades in a day.' Distinct from max_trades_range, which caps rangebound attempts specifically.
